title: Metadata
description: Metadata that every nodr document has.

name.description: The resource name, unique per kind in the workspace. Renaming is allowed.

uid.description: The identity nodr assigns when the resource is created. It survives renames and must not be edited.

labels.description: Key-value pairs used by selectors in policies, schedules, bindings and access rules. The nodr/ prefix is reserved.

annotations.description: Free-form metadata. The nodr/ prefix is reserved.
